consumer_gaps.summary: First-contact qualification of a non-genesis relay fails closed (UNTRUSTED_RELAY_IDENTITY) unless the descriptor-trust store already holds the exact genesis→head chain. The drills seed the store by walking the chain live (content-hash fetched, client-verified). Production needs the same bootstrap in the descriptor-trust-backend path.

createBlindCellRelay defaults leaseClass 4; the deployed public-test admission offers CELL PUT only at leaseClass 1 (10 units) — an unredeemed default fails SPEND_INVALID. Drills pass leaseClass 1 explicitly. The adapter should negotiate from verified admission parameters.

Relay descriptors advertise placeholder protocol/transport profileHash values (0x0a/0x0b patterns, disclosed DAL1-IAR-P2-1), so the qualifier's contradiction pins are currently vacuous; descriptor hash + signature + chain + admission binding remain the substantive checks.
